name: postwind
description: Tailwind CSS v4 runtime with pipe notation, shortcuts, visible: animations, and more - compiler bundled, no CDN

scripts.build: rm -rf dist/ && bun build src/postwind.js --outfile dist/postwind.js --format esm && bun build src/postwind.js --outfile dist/postwind.min.js --format esm --minify && bun build src/postwind.js --outfile dist/postwind.global.js --format iife && bun build src/postwind.js --outfile dist/postwind.global.min.js --format iife --minify
scripts.dev: bun bin/server.js & bun build src/postwind.js --outfile dist/postwind.global.js --format iife --watch

author: Dux
